summary: [Shopify] idempotency: No native idempotency-key on Admin mutations in retrieved docs. Webhook handlers idempotent by (topic, resource id). Mutation retry-safety client-side: read-before-write, record returned ids, reconcile on timeout; check userErrors in mutation payloads (validation failures separate from top-level errors; GraphQL returns HTTP 200 on errors: always inspect the errors key). Bulk operations give async, checkable execution.
followup: Verify current Shopify idempotency guidance at build time.
